scenario.title: Storage unavailable: fail closed, never fall back
scenario.invariant: When the shared store cannot answer, a worker refuses (503) and never accepts, never delivers, and never falls back to a local in-memory store; a worker with no store configuration refuses to start.
faultSchedule: Start a worker with no store setting, with an empty one and with an unknown backend: each must exit with the configuration refusal code (78).
Start a worker pointing at a sqlite file that does not exist: it must refuse to start (70) and must not create the file.
Start worker-a and worker-b on one shared sqlite file. Build a pull-mode credential.

Hold an exclusive write lock on the database from the runner, present the credential to both workers (expect 503, no acceptance, no broadcast), release the lock, present again (expect it to be accepted once: the failed attempts did not consume it).
Build a second credential, delete the database file under the running workers, present it (expect 503 and an unhealthy /health), then try to restart a worker on the missing file (expect refusal).

checks.description: A worker with no store configuration (unset, empty or unknown) refuses to start with exit code 78.
checks.detail: unset: exit 78; empty: exit 78; unknown backend: exit 78 | message: chargeguard worker refused to start: no store configured: set CHARGEGUARD_STORE to 'sqlite:<path>' (shared, durable) or, for a demonstration of the failure, 'memory'. Refusing to start without one.

checks.description: A worker pointed at a sqlite file that does not exist refuses to start (exit 70) instead of creating an empty private store.
checks.detail: exit 70: chargeguard worker refused to start: sqlite store file does not exist: /tmp/chargeguard-run-8tjN9d/does-not-exist.db

checks.description: While the database is locked both workers answer 503 and accept nothing.
No transaction for the credential reaches the chain while the store cannot record the claim.
After the lock is released the same credential is accepted once (the failed attempts did not consume it) and not twice.
checks.detail: after unlock: worker-b 200, then worker-a replay 402.

checks.description: With the database file deleted both workers answer 503 and accept nothing (no silent fall back to a local map).
The worker's health endpoint reports the store as unhealthy (503).
A worker restarted against the missing database refuses to start (exit 70).
Each payment is delivered at most once (counted from the workers' fulfillment logs).
Each challenge is delivered against at most once.
checks.detail: no challenge was delivered more than once.

checks.description: Client-observed responses match the workers' own request and fulfillment logs.
checks.detail: client saw 9 responses (1 accepted); workers logged 9 requests (1 accepted) and 1 fulfillments.

observations: Challenge issuance does not touch the store (the id is an HMAC), so a worker with a locked store still issues challenges: it answered 402. Only verification needs the store.

payments.note: 1 worker response accepted the credential; the transaction was submitted by the worker; chain: SUCCESS; the resource was delivered 1 time.
no worker accepted the credential; no transaction submission was observed; chain: NOT_FOUND; the resource was never delivered.
